title: Mind Captioning (D2) internally-generated semantic/event imagery qualification
trigger: inspected because C3XB (GOD) decision = C3XB_GOD_CATEGORY_IMAGERY_FAIL (fallback precondition satisfied); no dataset-level outcome fishing

provenance.operative_source: preprocessed .mat (figshare) ONLY; raw and preprocessed not mixed
provenance.cache_rule: only files matching pinned figshare file_id + supplied_md5 accepted; SHA-256 computed on download

content_scope.modality: internally-generated SEMANTIC/EVENT (cued recall of dynamic natural video clips, Cowen & Keltner 2017)

imagery.unit_rule: each of the 5 sessions contains all 72 videos exactly once

correspondence.certified_from: imageryID set == stimID set (video identity), NOT row order

trial_contract.exclusions: none (all 72 videos have 5 clean imagery reps; no catch trials); behavioural accuracy/vividness NEVER used to select trials

roi_contract.source: released metainf.roiname localizer functional ROIs (officially released); hemisphere pair localizer_r_{lh,rh}.<area>
roi_contract.gating_roi: VC only; earlyVC/LVC/HVC are secondary/descriptive (cue control + interpretation), NOT gating

imagery_estimator.independent_unit: SESSION (5 fully-balanced units; one trial per (session, video)) -- passed as the `pair` argument
imagery_estimator.rationale: D2 sessions satisfy the run-pair estimator precondition (each unit covers all 72 contents exactly once), so the frozen C3XB estimator applies directly with unit:=session; within-session label-permutation null preserves acquisition structure
imagery_estimator.statistic: R_I = Spearman-Brown-corrected Pearson r of concatenated 72-video-mean patterns across disjoint session-halves (5 -> 2 vs 2, 2 reps/video/half)
imagery_estimator.permutation_null: permute video identities WITHIN each session; n_perm=1000
imagery_estimator.bootstrap: non-straddling hierarchical: fix disjoint session-halves, resample whole sessions within each half with replacement; n_boot=1000
imagery_estimator.accelerator: c3xb_fast.reliability_with_inference_pairs_fast (validated BIT-IDENTICAL to the frozen estimator on synthetic fixtures AND on >=1 real committed subject before large-scale use)

perception_control.estimator: c3x_reliability run-disjoint (FROZEN) on perception runs (10) / reps; global content-label permutation null
perception_control.statistic: R_P (matched video-identity perception reliability, same VC ROI)
perception_control.mode: full inference where feasible; documented point-only fallback anchored to a full-inference subject (C3XA/C3XB precedent) permitted

cue_control.structural_fact: imagery samples show NO video (stimID=0, cueID=0) -> target-presentation leakage structurally absent in the recall window
audit: temporal-window certification (block-averaged recall period; no within-trial axis -> early-vs-late deferred, needs raw BIDS)
cue_control.rule: primary reliability admissible only if CLEAN or CONTROLLED; CUE_AMBIGUOUS -> report with explicit limitation and do NOT upgrade; CUE_FAIL -> C3XC_BLOCKED_BY_CUE_PROVENANCE

subject_gate: R_I>0 AND perm p<0.05 AND bootstrap CI lower>0 AND min-over-seeds>0 -> PASS; else MARGINAL (R_I>0, a criterion fails) or NOISE_FLOOR (R_I<=0) [frozen subject_reliability_gate]

dataset_gate.qualified: >=2/6 subjects imagery PASS AND matched perception PASS AND cue control acceptable (CLEAN/CONTROLLED) -> C3XC_D2_SEMANTIC_IMAGERY_QUALIFIED
dataset_gate.blocked: contract/unit uncertifiable or cue CUE_FAIL -> C3XC_BLOCKED_*
dataset_gate.aggregation: count subjects independently; do NOT average subjects before subject-level qualification

multiplicity: single prespecified gating ROI (VC); secondary ROIs descriptive only; no ROI selection after observing reliability

downstream_authorization.on_qualified: at most a FUTURE, separately-prespecified, D2-content-scoped (semantic/event video-recall) reliability-bounded analysis

fail_closed: correspondence != 72/72 -> report exact subset, do not silently drop
accelerator not proven equivalent -> use frozen only
fallback_behavior: if C3XC FAIL/BLOCKED, record the next candidate ONLY (do not execute)

integrity.behavioural_ratings: descriptive only, never used to select trials
